<b>Grindle</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. He is a thieving [[Snitchbugs|Snitchbug]] who can be found in multiple locations. He eventually settles in the [[Blasted Steps]] and exchanges various goods for [[Rosaries]].

== Background ==
Grindle is a member of the [[Snitchbugs]], a group of thieves that pilfer and scavenge goods from [[Pharloom]]'s citizens and ruins.<ref>[[Snitchfly]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Pernicious looter found all over Pharloom."</i></ref> This is indicated by the [[Thief's Mark]], which identifies the wearer as a member.<ref>Thief's Mark description: <i>"Symbol worn to identify oneself to fellow thieves."</i></ref>

Grindle was eventually locked up in a jail cell in [[the Marrow]] for something he calls "light thievery".<ref>Grindle: <i>"Hoy! Hoyyyy! You there! Get us out of here! Since when's a little light thievery worth a lifelong sentence?"</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Grindle is first encountered in a jail cell in the Marrow, located below the entrance to [[Hunter's March]]. [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can free him by repeatedly attacking the bars. If he is not freed, he later escapes by himself once Hornet reaches the [[Far Fields]] or [[Shellwood]].

If Hornet returns to Grindle's prison after freeing him but before entering the Far Fields or Shellwood, he can be found at the bottom of the room looting bags on the floor. He offers to sell secrets to Hornet in exchange for [[Rosaries]].<ref>Grindle: <i>"O-hoho! Share some of your little clicky-clackies with us, help us fill our pockets. If you do, we'll share a sneaky secret with you!"</i></ref>

He can later be found in the north-west area of the [[Choral Chambers]], where he is hiding inside a container while being harassed by a [[Reed]]. After saving Grindle and resting on a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]], he can be found looting a chest in one of three possible places in the Choral Chambers and the [[High Halls]]. This prevents Hornet from collecting the contents herself. Grindle only loots one of the chests and ignores the others.

If Hornet has been taken to [[the Slab]] by a [[Wardenfly]], Grindle can be found in the central east. He is first seen behind a door locked by [[Key of Indolent]], and later found next to the bench in the room on the opposite side. He leaves once Hornet retrieves her belongings.

Later, he can be found in the [[Blasted Steps]], along with several other Snitchbugs in his hideout, which can be reached using the [[Faydown Cloak]]. He opens a shop here and sells goods. 

In [[Act 3]], Grindle sells various unique goods if the merchants who originally sold them have died, as long as those items are not found near those merchants' corpses.

== Location ==
Grindle can first be found in the eastern portion of [[the Marrow]], within a jail cell. He can also be found later in [[the Slab]] if [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has been taken there by a [[Wardenfly]]. Grindle can be found inside a container, hiding from a [[Reed]] within the western section of the [[Choral Chambers]], and once saved there, he can appear looting a chest in either the Choral Chambers or the [[High Halls]]. Grindle's shop can be found in the northern [[Blasted Steps]], which requires the [[Faydown Cloak]] to reach.

== Creation and Development ==
[[File:Grindle.gif|thumb|250px|Grindle's 2020 riddle gif]]
Grindle is the second of a series of NPCs teased using riddles provided by [https://twitter.com/griffinmatta Matthew "Leth" Griffin] that lasted throughout June to July of 2020. The others being [[Huntress]], the [[Flea Caravan]], and [[Shrine Guardian Seth]]. 
The following description was provided upon the riddles being solved, alongside the promotional art and a gif:

: <i>"Hoho, free at last! Locked up in here much too long, we was! Nasty place to keep a poor little snitchbug! You're smellin' fancy though... Bet you got some nice shinies hidden in that cloak!"</i>

: <i>A common snitchbug, fixated on thievery. Though he has travelled the lengths of [[Pharloom]], he's seen most of it through the iron bars of cages and cells. Free at last, he's taking full advantage of the kingdom's ailing state.</i>

: <i>This sneaky thief will gladly take [[rosaries]] in exchange for snippets of information he has gathered, though his gossip is often of questionable value.</i><ref>Description in the [https://discordapp.com/channels/283467363729408000/586931790208434203/724730813887021158 file] where Grindle was revealed.</ref>

The riddle solved to reveal this character featured clues that hinted at different characters from the [[Hollow Knight|first game]]. The riddle and solution are outlined below:

"I am a fly of little fame
But here's your chance to know my name 
I dwell in land of silk and song
And I don't feel that thieving's wrong"

"I hope that you won't think me rude
But I am in a riddling mood 
So now I speak a clue or two
To recall names of Things you knew"

"The first of Things has known no peer
You find him in a realm of tears
He wields a hammer but needs a nail
And seeks a trinket, metallic and pale"

<i>Answer: [[Nailsmith]]</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"Another Thing with friendly face
And you can find them any place
They may be found both near and far
And freely if not for a jar"

<i>Answer: [[Grubs|Grub]]</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"The next Thing you find everywhere
But few are sure it's really there
Corrupt yet "does it have a mind?"
It's in their eyes but are they blind?"

<i>Answer: [[The Infection|Infection]]</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"The first of letters in his name
And the sixth of mine are same
But if you have nothing to buy
His speech may begin with a sigh"

<i>Answer: [[Relic Seeker Lemm|Lemm]]</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"The fifth character of this game
Are capital letters in his name
And if you face him you will find
He guards what exits from behind"

<i>Answer: [[Dung Defender]]</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"The next Thing is a simple one
And angry once her rest is done
She'll fly while bouncing to and fro
And inside her the babies grow"

<i>Answer: [[Gruz Mother]]</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"And now the last Thing finally
Confessed to her regretfully
Rarely would you see its eyes
For inside of you this Thing lies"

<i>Answer: [[Shade]]</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"Three seers from the tube of you
Shared wisdom June of one and two
Revealing my name is no small feat
Three key rules were theirs to tweet"

<i>Answer: Three YouTubers who posted the next three clues on Twitter (mossbag <ref>{{Cite tweet|author=mossbag|user=mossbag69|number=1275171707087720450|title=These Things are much more than words(...)|access-date=22 June 2020}}</ref>, Relyea <ref>{{Cite tweet|author=Relyea|user=helyearelyea|number=1275171703035838465|title=The first two letters of my name(...)|access-date=22 June 2020}}</ref>, and Rusty <ref>{{Cite tweet|author=Rusty|user=TSF_Rusty|number=1275171787358306307|title=The third and fourth letters of mine(...)|access-date=22 June 2020}}</ref>)</i>

{{Hr|small|margin=0 0 24px}}

"These Things are much more than words
The last of Things defeats the third
Though with the third I share the first letter
The other's last letter suits me better"
<i>Answer: Letter "E" (From Shade)</i>

"The first two letters of my name
Are definitely not the same
But two of the Things from this rhyme
Share the first two letters of mine"
<i>Answer: Letters "GR" (From Grub and Gruz Mother)</i>

"The third and fourth letters of mine
Are first in two Things equally wide
To know these two Things we need the width
Subtract three from the count of the fifth"
<i>Answer: Letters "IN" (From Infection and Nailsmith)</i>
<i>DL" (From Dung Defender and Lemm)</i>

<i>Final result: GR IN DL E (Grindle)</i>
</div></td><td style="width:8px;"></td></tr></table>
